name: Kleurenwiezen
summary: Belgian four-player trick-taking game where bidding decides trump suit and whether play is 2v2 or 1v3.
rules_text: 4 players use a 52-card deck. Deal 13 cards each clockwise in 4-5-4 packets, no shuffle just a cut. Bidding starts left of dealer. Options: pass (out), wait (only first bidder, may later accept), propose a trump suit you hold, accept a live proposal to form a pair committed to that suit, pass parole when 11+ tricks would be needed, and Solo alone contracts. A proposal lasts one round. Formed partnerships must contract at least 8 tricks, Solos 5-8 tricks. Auction raises trick number; if equal, suit rank Hearts>Diamonds>Clubs>Spades decides, lower must bid one more. Other contracts like Misere exist. Highest contract plays. Play 13 tricks: must follow suit if able, highest trump wins otherwise highest of led suit wins. Partners combine tricks. Score by contract type, tricks made vs bid, and bonus/penalty table.
rating_reason: Specific Belgian bidding trick-taking, partnerships determined by bid.
